items.title: Linux Patch Management
items.text:
Provides a single dashboard to check, track, and install software updates across Ubuntu and Fedora Linux computers.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Linux

items.title: Integration with JIRA ITSM
items.text:
Automatically creates structured IT support tickets in Jira whenever Hexnode detects a device issue or security alert, keeping support teams informed without manual data entry.
Badge: New Feature

items.title: macOS software update via DDM
items.text:
Upgrading macOS software update management to use Apple's Declarative Device Management (DDM) framework, replacing legacy MDM commands for more reliable and enforceable OS updates.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS

items.title: Platform SSO
items.text:
Allows Mac users to log into their computer using their main cloud work account (such as Entra ID or Okta) and gain seamless single sign-on access to all corporate apps without re-entering passwords.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS

items.title: Deploy e-sim on Android devices
items.text:
Enables IT administrators to wirelessly push cellular eSIM profiles directly to company Android devices, replacing physical SIM cards and guiding users through simple setup prompts.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Android

items.title: Pre-Approved enrollment for Windows devices
items.text:
Enables bulk CSV pre-approval onboarding for Windows devices by enforcing a mandatory tripartite hardware match (Serial Number, Manufacturer Name, and Model Name) to prevent spoofing and streamline large-scale deployments.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.key: Remarks for Patch Failure as a Report|2026-09-22
items.title: Remarks for Patch Failure as a Report
items.text:
Generates a consolidated report detailing the exact reasons why a software patch failed on specific devices, making troubleshooting fast and simple.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.title: Windows Server Management
items.text:
Enroll and manage Windows Servers alongside desktops to centralize patching, remote actions, and security from a single console.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.title: File Deployment for Windows
items.text:
Securely push files from the Hexnode repository to Windows devices and deploy them directly to the desired location.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.title: ServiceNow integration
items.text:
Sync device data bi-directionally to track inventory and trigger remote actions like lock or wipe right from your service desk!
Badge: New Feature

items.title: Return to Service
items.text:
Remotely wipe Apple devices and have them automatically reconnect, skip setup, and re-enroll into Hexnode instantly!
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: iOS, visionOS

items.title: Deploy root certificates
items.text:
Easily deploy root and intermediate certificates to Windows devices for secure, automated Wi-Fi and VPN authentication.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.key: Incident Filters for Dynamic Device Groups|2026-04-17
items.title: Incident Filters for Dynamic Device Groups
items.text:
Automatically group and manage devices based on real-time data, including unresolved incident counts, severity levels, and specific app or security failures.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, ChromeOS, Linux, Apple TV, Android TV, visionOS

items.title: Execute Custom Scripts on Android
items.text:
This new remote action allows you to run Shell or Hexnode custom scripts directly from the portal, enabling faster troubleshooting and immediate task automation at the device level.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Android

items.title: Enhanced App Uninstallation
items.text:
Cleanly remove software and residual files with this redesigned uninstallation flow. You can also track success or failure with native OS return codes for deeper insights into every removal.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.title: Hexnode LAPS for macOS
items.text:
Secure local administrator accounts by automatically rotating unique passwords for every Mac and storing them in an encrypted escrow to eliminate risks from password reuse.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS

items.title: Lost Mode for macOS
items.text:
Ensure your devices are always findable with mandatory location tracking policies that use GPS for precision or Reverse IP as a reliable backup when GPS is unavailable.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS

items.title: Android Device Owner Conversion
items.text:
Remotely upgrade rooted Android devices to full administrative status over the air, eliminating the need for manual setup or physical device recalls.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Android

items.title: Hexnode Genie AI enhancements
items.text:
Experience a smarter workflow with full-screen search shortcuts, instant analysis of failed actions, and the ability to export generated data lists for easy reporting.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, ChromeOS, Linux, Apple TV, Android TV, visionOS

items.title: ⁠Custom attributes
items.text:
Create and store unique data points for your devices, users, and groups by defining your own specialized fields. Use these attributes as dynamic wildcards across the portal to personalize configurations and automate your workflows with ease.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, ChromeOS, Linux, Apple TV, Android TV, visionOS

items.title: Support for Zebra printers
items.text:
Remotely manage and configure Zebra printers by enrolling them directly into Hexnode. Easily push printer profiles to deploy essential settings, fonts, and templates across your fleet, ensuring consistent performance without manual setup.
Badge: New Feature

items.title: ⁠One login support for Hexnode Access
items.text:
Hexnode Access now supports OneLogin, enabling users to sign in to Windows devices with their OneLogin credentials. This update expands our identity provider options alongside Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, and Okta for a more unified login experience.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.title: Execute intent on Android devices
items.text:
Remotely trigger specific app functions or system tasks on Android devices using custom intents. This allows IT admins to execute targeted actions across the fleet instantly without manual intervention.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Android

items.title: Registry editor
items.text:
Deploy Registry keys and values directly via policies, eliminating the need for manual edits or complex PowerShell scripts. This streamlined approach lets you manage system configurations across your Windows fleet with just a few clicks.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: Windows

items.title: CIS compliance
items.text:
Quickly align macOS and Windows devices with CIS benchmarks using Hexnode’s pre-configured policy templates. These templates ensure your fleet meets essential security standards without disrupting user productivity.
Badge: New Feature
Platforms: macOS, Windows
